evidence.excerpt: 全体都是黄金作色，身躯分为头、胸腹、尾三段。头部如半月铲

design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE GOLD-colored DUNG BEETLE Gu in canonical eight-rank freshly refined stage. Three clear contiguous body regions: head like a semicircular digging SHOVEL, chest/abdomen with several transverse raised ridges, and oval tail region. TWO PADDLE-shaped short antennae on sides of head, not pointed horns. Six robust grounded limbs: TWO PAIRS on chest/abdomen region, ONE PAIR at oval tail region. Every thick foot ends in short hard BLACK BRISTLES; natural digging legs not human hands. Entire body golden-colored dense living cuticle, subdued burnished ochre-gold highlights, a biological beetle not a golden statue, gemstone jewelry, plated robot, crown or ornament. Slightly elevated three-quarter view lets viewer read halfmoon shovel head and transverse ridges, all legs in frame, tiny neutral eyes subordinate to shovel head. Rest on plain dark bare dry soil with quiet granular texture, dim warm-grey background, no green garden, flower, literal excrement ball, dog, treasure piles or golden aura. Physical warm sidelight reveals real curved gold shell and black bristles; deep cool dark shadows, no gacha sparkle or shiny precious accessories. It is humble utilitarian beetle form, its gold color comes from explicit novel fact rather than luxury adornment.

visible_facts: 黄金蜣螂体、半月铲头、两侧桨状触角、横向隆脊与椭圆尾
六粗足末端有黑色硬毛爪，完整本体和银框，无粪球或宝石
risks: 黄金高光较强、足关节略像金属装甲；未加外部首饰
黑毛末端细节与脚爪混合，形态精确到每根刺不可保证
